data.raw_text:
Done with my coffee break. Another thing...

Forget about traffic rules when you're in Metro Manila—whether you're driving or walking.

If you're behind the wheel of a big rig or SUV, you're practically king of the road. You get to decide who goes first—and more often than not, it's you. Regular cars follow, then the swarm of motorcycles weaving through every gap they can find.

And pedestrians? They're dead last. Those on foot—whether waiting for a jeepney, crossing the street, or just trying to survive the chaos—basically have no rights.

Unless you push back. I’ve pulled a few “Midnight Cowboy” moments myself—channeling Dustin Hoffman with a loud “Hey, I’m walkin’ here!” accompanied with a finger motion.(Kids, don't try this unless you got enough balls on you to fight back). Sometimes, just holding up your palm like you're parting the Red Sea gets drivers to slow down. Not always, but often enough to stay alive.
